name: @solid-native/testing
description: Deterministic renderer and native device testing tools.

scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && node --check benchmark/*.mjs && node --check test/strict-solid-diagnostics.mjs
scripts.benchmark: pnpm --filter '@solid-native/testing...' build && node --conditions=browser --expose-gc benchmark/causal-overhead.mjs && node --conditions=browser --expose-gc benchmark/native-navigation.mjs && node --conditions=browser --expose-gc benchmark/virtualized-list.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm --filter '@solid-native/testing...' build && node --conditions=browser --test test/*.test.mjs && node --conditions=browser --conditions=development --import ./test/strict-solid-diagnostics.mjs --test test/*.test.mjs
